description: Hand-labelled cases used to measure the faithfulness judge itself before trusting its verdicts. `supported` is the ground truth: true only if EVERY claim in the answer is stated in the sources. Faithful answers are paraphrased; unfaithful ones contain a wrong number, a claim absent from the sources, or outside knowledge.
